title: Psalm 97 (I Exalt Thee)
lyrics_original: For Thou, Oh, Lord, art high above all the earth:
Thou art exalted far above all gods.
For Thou, Oh, Lord, art high above all the earth:
Thou art exalted far above all gods.
For Thou, Oh, Lord, art high above all the earth:
Thou art exalted far above all gods.
For Thou, Oh, Lord, art high above all the earth:
Thou art exalted far above all gods.

bible_verses.english: For you, Yahweh, are most high above all the earth. You are greatly exalted far above all gods.
The lofty looks of man will be humbled, and the haughtiness of men will be bowed down, and Yahweh alone will be exalted in that day.

Yours, Yahweh, is the greatness, the power, the glory, the victory, and the majesty; for all that is in the heavens and in the earth is yours. Yours is the kingdom, Yahweh, and you are exalted as head above all.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, You are high above all the earth, exalted far above every power and concern. Today, I choose to lift Your name above my worries, my ambition, and every distraction around me. Be exalted in my thoughts, my words, and my daily choices. I joyfully yield my heart to Your reigning love, trusting that You hold my life safely in Your hands. Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: When life feels overwhelming or filled with distractions, lifting our voices in worship reminds us where our true focus belongs. Psalm 97 calls us to lift our eyes above earthly concerns to behold the transcendent majesty of our Lord. As we declare 'I Exalt Thee,' we yield our hearts, acknowledging that God reigns supreme over every anxiety and circumstance. Exalting Him rearranges our perspective, anchoring our faith in His everlasting glory and love.
